expected_direction: From 0 toward target 1 (increasing initially); documented springs can overshoot. Whether this numeric mass/tension/friction combination crosses within 3000 ms is 미확인 from common API alone.
boundary: Default clamp=false; stopping proximity is documented as precision and restVelocity. Exact threshold interplay and first stopping time are 미확인.
undetermined: whether a single emitted update briefly exceeds the goal
falsifier: With the specified start/goal/configuration and no cancellation/duration override, first moving sample decreases below 0; or official same-version API says this positive-tension animation does not target 1. Unknown crossing is not scored as a wrong numeric prediction.

input.boundary_selection: configData source order: mass,tension,friction,bounce,clamp,precision. clamp is first stopping/cancel/clamp option; bounce precedes it but redirects motion rather than declaring termination. Reference table precedes Pitfalls in document source.

expected_direction: Initially toward 1 as baseline; when goal crossing occurs clamp stops further oscillation. Config pitfalls state stopping at the goal value; the table phrases this as stopping once it overshoots.
boundary: Lock clamp=true. Predict termination at the first goal-crossing condition and final goal 1, conditional on crossing; continued oscillation after that event is excluded by the documented API. The exact emitted first-crossing sample and crossing time remain 미확인.
undetermined: whether this input reaches crossing by 3000 ms
single-update transient overshoot before clamp termination
falsifier: Same-version independent output with clamp=true continues to oscillate after first crossing, or terminal value remains beyond goal rather than settling to 1; distinguish this from a transient intermediate sample.
